description:
## What

A single workspace-level document for the 1.0 announcement. Location TBD — recommend top-level `/home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/RELEASE_NOTES.md` since the workspace already has a top-level `CHANGELOG.md` carrying detailed unified history.

## Contents per PKIX-wlsr.7

- Summary: 'RFC 5280 X.509 for Rust, done right from the start. 12 crates shipping at 1.0; adjacent ecosystem continues at independent 0.x cadence.'
- What's included: list of the 12 narrow-scope crates, one-line each (purpose + RFC scope)
- What's not included: AIA online fetching (`pkix-aia-http` post-1.0), AC (`pkix-ac`), CT (`pkix-ct`), DANE (`pkix-dane`), composite/PQC (`pkix-composite`), platform trust stores (`pkix-truststore-{system,pkcs11}`), comprehensive CA/B Forum policy adapter (`pkix-policy-zlint`, `pkix-policy-pkilint`) — all available as 0.x sibling crates with independent roadmaps
- Quick start example: show `verify_tls_server` hostname binding
- Stability promise: 1.0 = semver stability; future breaking changes require major bump
- Acknowledgments: RustCrypto upstream, NIST PKITS, pyca/cryptography, OpenSSL, others as appropriate

## Acceptance

- [ ] Document drafted at the chosen location
- [ ] Cross-references to per-crate CHANGELOGs work
- [ ] Quick-start example compiles (verify with `cargo doc` or extract as a real doctest somewhere)
- [ ] No fabricated content — every claim traces to real workspace state

## Cross-references

- PKIX-wlsr.7 (parent)
- PKIX-wlsr.7.1 (CHANGELOGs the RELEASE_NOTES references)
- PKIX-wlsr.7.2 (1.0 entries the RELEASE_NOTES summarizes)
